“
You can learn the skill from Rappanel in South Serbule. (He's in the inn.) As you advance in Bard skill, you will also need to improve other skills, including performance, vocabulary, and poetry appreciation. Rappanel should give you enough information to proceed at each stage. We need feedback on how easy/hard it is to advance as a bard! We also need feedback on the bard's general abilities and playability. Keep in mind that the bard is designed to be a support character. It is definitely possible to solo with the bard, but it's not going to be as fast as some other skills.
Note: the bardic music tracks are draft versions, not the finalized versions. There are small issues with the looping of some tracks, plus some pops and crackles in a few sound effects. These small issues will be fixed soon.
One other note: Bardic music is implemented as a "performance". This has many subtle ramifications, but one useful feature is that if you tire of hearing the bardic songs, you can go into the Configuration window's Audio tab and reduce the number of audible performers to zero.
—
March 25, 2017 Patch Notes
Bard Overview
Bard
is a skill intended for Adventurers looking to provide support to their fellow travelers. The Bard skillset can only be used by humanoid races at this time, and travelers confined to
Beast Forms
will find it difficult, even impossible to use.
In-Game Description
Bardin'
Training Bard

Serbule Hills

Bard

Thunderous Note: Simple attack for Lute bards, can be modded for higher attack range. Can be modded to be nature damage and debuff enemies to take more damage from nature.
Entrancing Lullaby:
Mezmerize
an enemy, crowd control.
Rally: Major
Healing
for a single target. Can be modded to restore power and armor.
Song of Resurgence: Constant
healing
for all allies near you. Can be modded to restore power too. Can be modded to increase your major healing power.
Song of Discord: Powerful constant direct trauma damage to all enemies, medium range. Can be modded to
reduce rage
and/or
stun

Anthem of Avoidance: Support, give all allies evasion to projectiles. Can be modded for melee and burst evasion.

Bard Mechanics
Bards can play with a lute and/or horn. Horn abilities focus on dealing damage, lute abilities are songs (see below).
Songs
Bards using a lute can play a song for constant effects like healing or damage. When moving, the song is interrupted so it is a good idea to pull groups of enemies or have a high range attack to pull. Switching to a different song will interrupt the current song.
Weapons
Lute instruments are all MainHand, while everything else is OffHand. Even though only the Lutes are tagged as Wooden,
Druids
may use all instruments.
